title: palcheck §8 routed legs (d)+(e) skip the testing_lvl_ok guard every other leg has — a failed premise panics instead of reporting
detail: Legs (a),(b),(c),(f),(g) guard on testing_lvl_ok; (d)+(e) doesn't. crisis_make allocates pipe_congestion empty and this render-only fixture never runs warnings_update, so a failed premise indexes an empty array — a bounds panic, not the designed failed-premise check.
recommended_fix: Wrap the (d)+(e) block in `if testing_lvl_ok { ... }` like the sibling legs, so a premise failure records the section-8 premise FAIL and skips instead of crashing palcheck.

title: Test comment claims 'byte-exact v2 color at the pulse floor' but the trough glow share is 0.4428, not the classic 0.43
detail: PULSE16[0]=0.04 makes the trough glow share 0.4428, not the classic 0.43; only the steady core pass is byte-exact v2. palcheck's own trough_share8 pins 0.4428 — the comment's natural reading is false and would mislead a future golden pin.
recommended_fix: Reword to: the trough glow is 0.4428 (PULSE16 floor 0.04); only the steady core pass renders the byte-exact 0.43 v2 recolor — align test and §3 comments with palcheck's trough_share8 math.
